Luiz, it's Sandra from compliance, about the Rezende file. You may approve up to the agreed limit, because they are an existing customer. You may not go above it. Anything above the limit has to go to the finance director, and she is away until Monday. If there is collateral in that file, legal must sign off before you release anything. And you should put the sixty-day request in writing today. You do not have to decide today. You do have to record it.

Luiz, Marco. Two rules before you answer Rezende. You must not release new product on any account that is more than ninety days overdue. That rule is not mine and I cannot change it. Second, verbal approval does not exist here. If somebody tells you on the telephone that it is fine, you should ask them to send it in writing, and you may say that I told you to. You are allowed to be the difficult one. That is the job.
